title: Multi-Tenant BGP Policy Engine State
description: Schema for the /app/state.json output produced by the orchestrator after configuring GoBGP.

asn.description: The global BGP ASN from tenants.json global.asn

router_id.description: The global router ID from tenants.json global.router_id

prefix_sets.description: One global bogon set named 'bogon-prefixes' (containing all entries from global.bogon_prefixes) plus one per tenant named 'tenant-{name}-prefixes' (containing that tenant's allowed_prefixes).

community_sets.description: Two per tenant: 'tenant-{name}-community' holding the tenant's own community_tag (identity), and 'tenant-{name}-export-allowed' holding the community tags of the tenant itself plus every tenant listed in its export_to_tenants.

as_path_sets.description: One per tenant that has a non-empty reject_as_origins list, named 'tenant-{name}-reject-origins'. Each entry is a regex matching routes originated by the rejected ASN.

policies.description: One global policy named 'global-bogon-reject', plus per tenant: 'tenant-{name}-import' (enforces prefix filtering, origin rejection if applicable, community tagging, MED, AS-prepend) and 'tenant-{name}-export' (allows routes matching permitted tenant communities, rejects all others).

statements.description: List of statement names within this policy

peer_groups.description: One per tenant named 'pg-{name}', with peer_asn matching the tenant's ASN. Each peer group binds its tenant's import and export policies.
